name: drop_public_prefix_from_tenants
description: Drop tenants.public_prefix (and its UNIQUE constraint). The slug prefix moved to the SAM plane: it is now SAM-owned on the config#fields row, authored via ConfigFieldsCrudService.set_public_prefix (POST /members/application-form/prefix) and read via MembersProjectionReader.get_public_prefix. Flask no longer stores, projects, or backfills it (the add-migration 20261112120000 + its backfill_tenant_public_prefix.py data step and the projection_builder passthrough were removed). Reverses 20261112120000. MySQL 9.4: no IF EXISTS on indexes/columns — idempotency comes from the migration tracker, not SQL syntax; drop the UNIQUE index before the column.
up: ALTER TABLE tenants DROP INDEX uq_tenants_public_prefix
ALTER TABLE tenants DROP COLUMN public_prefix
down: ALTER TABLE tenants ADD COLUMN public_prefix VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Short, globally-unique, slug-safe public tenant prefix (legacy; superseded by the SAM-owned config#fields.public_prefix).'
ALTER TABLE tenants ADD CONSTRAINT uq_tenants_public_prefix UNIQUE (public_prefix)
